target: a multi-step goal across the catalog
prompt: I'm launching a small SaaS web app next week. I want it safe to ship, fast, and found on Google afterwards. Which of your skills do I run, in what order, and what does each hand the next?

checks.desc: routes through the release gate lanes

rubric: Picks real catalog skills only, in a sensible order (ship checks before launch, SEO after)
Covers exposure (web-preflight), security (pre-ship-security-red-team), performance (pre-ship-performance-audit) or the release-gate chair that runs all three
Covers being found (seo-crawl/seo-sweep, get-indexed, findable or keyword-guard)
States what each step hands the next
Says which steps need the user's go-ahead
